question: T12, U4: an Accordion toolbar on desktop and a taller one: where Align Vertically moves it. Made in this session on a probe page.
answer: Desktop bar: Edit 108.1, Align Vertically 153.1, Pin 193.1, Duplicate 238.1, Remove 278.1, so 45 from Edit to Align. Align Vertically's default is Top. On 1/2/12/10, 441 high with 301 of content, Align Bottom writes justify flex-end and moves the content 140.1 down.
